description: Maps Company OS role contracts to Claude Code subagents. The role markdown is the subagent system prompt verbatim; this file adds only the runtime binding (tools, model tier, deny patterns).

agents.name: strategy-lead
agents.description: Frames strategic questions, synthesizes analyst outputs into a decision record with at least two options. Never decides. Use after analysts have written their handoff artifacts.

agents.name: market-intelligence-analyst
agents.description: Market position, competitor landscape, and external research from rated sources. Use for any commission needing outside-in evidence.

agents.name: business-performance-analyst
agents.description: Measures performance from systems of record under catalog definitions; unit economics, variance, cohorts. Use for any commission needing the company's own numbers.

agents.name: long-range-planner
agents.description: Multi-year scenarios with sensitivities, assumptions register, capital and resourcing proposals, strategic risk register. Use when a commission has a horizon beyond four quarters.

agents.name: corporate-development-analyst
agents.description: Exit readiness, valuation range, buyer landscape, diligence gaps, inbound-interest logging. Operates only inside .agentic/ledger/corpdev/. Never contacts anyone.

agents.name: adversarial-reviewer
agents.description: Attacks a recommendation's evidence, assumptions, option set, and producer incentives. Run before any decision record is delivered.
